journey.name: forgot pin sheet clears navigation bar
journey.description:
The "Forgot PIN?" sheet keeps its "Reset (Requires Recovery Phrase)" button above the navigation bar. The sheet host applies no bottom inset, so the sheet content has to; without it the button sits under the gesture handle on devices with gesture navigation.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet with gesture navigation enabled on the device and the PIN disabled (Settings ▸ Security ▸ PIN Code shows "Disabled"), no biometrics enrolled on the device. Start on the wallet home screen. The journey enables a PIN you choose and disables it again at the end, so remember it. Enter a wrong PIN exactly once: exhausting attempts leads to the forgot-PIN wallet reset, and never tap the Reset button.
Read the navigation-bar top edge from the NavigationBar window frame in `adb shell dumpsys window windows`, or from the bottom of the screen minus the navigation-bar inset. The Reset button carries no tag; find it in `android layout` by its text. On iOS, compare the button frame from `snapshot-ui` against the home indicator safe area instead.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (tag "HeaderMenu") and tap Settings (tag "DrawerSettings")
Tap the Security tab (tag "Tab-security")
Tap PIN Code (tag "PINCode")
Tap Enable PIN (tag "EnablePin")
Enter a 4-digit PIN with the number pad (tags "N0"–"N9")
Re-enter the same 4-digit PIN to confirm it
On the biometrics screen, tap Skip (tag "SkipButton")
Tap OK (tag "OK")
Run adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME and wait 3 seconds
Run adb shell am start -n to.bitkit.dev/to.bitkit.ui.MainActivity
Verify the PIN pad is visible (testTag "PinPad")
Enter one wrong 4-digit PIN
Verify the attempts text (tag "AttemptsRemaining") reads "... attempts remaining. Forgot your PIN?"
Tap the attempts text (tag "AttemptsRemaining")
Verify the "Forgot PIN?" sheet is visible (tag "ForgotPIN")
Verify the bottom bound of the "Reset (Requires Recovery Phrase)" button is above the navigation-bar top edge
Take a screenshot and verify the gesture handle does not overlap the Reset button
Press back and verify the PIN pad is visible again (testTag "PinPad")
Enter the PIN chosen above and verify the wallet home screen is visible (testTag "Send")
Tap the menu button (tag "HeaderMenu") and tap Settings (tag "DrawerSettings")
Tap the Security tab (tag "Tab-security")
Tap PIN Code (tag "PINCode")
Tap Disable PIN (tag "DisablePin") and enter the PIN chosen above on the disable sheet (tag "DisablePIN")
Verify the PIN Code row (tag "PINCode") shows "Disabled"
